# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `jobber` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.getjobber.com/mcp`.
- Auth is OAuth against `api.getjobber.com` with a client ID and secret from a Jobber Developer Center app, since Jobber does not support Dynamic Client Registration.
- Logo: Jobber's official mark, from the `GetJobber` GitHub organization.
